name: a fully credited invoice has settleable 0 and the ratio is NEVER evaluated -- the base is 0 by branch, not by division

expected.workings: 60000 of the line was credited by a note carrying lines and a further 40000 by a clearance note carrying none, so creditedPaise reaches the whole 100000 while creditedBasePaise reaches only 60000. eligibleBase = 100000 - 60000 = 40000, which is NOT zero -- so the zero below is the branch and not the numerator. settleable = 100000 - 100000 = 0. collected = 100000 - 0 = 100000, and the patient's money has not been given back yet. targetBase = 0 by the settleable === 0 branch; divHalfUp would have REFUSED d = 0 outright (it throws invalid_paise), which is what makes the branch load-bearing rather than defensive. target = 0. delta = 0 - 4000 = -4000.
